import time

@dataclass
class CacheEntry:
    """
    Represents a single entry in the cache.
    
    Attributes:
        key: The cache key.
        value: The cached value.
        expiry_time: Unix timestamp when this entry expires. None means no expiry.
        created_at: Unix timestamp when this entry was created.
        accessed_at: Unix timestamp of the last access.
    """
    key: Hashable
    value: Any
    expiry_time: Optional[float] = None
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    accessed_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    def is_expired(self) -> bool:
        """
        Check if the cache entry has expired.
        
        Returns:
            True if the entry has expired, False otherwise.
        """
        if self.expiry_time is None:
            return False
        return time.time() > self.expiry_time

    def touch(self) -> None:
        """
        Update the accessed_at timestamp to the current time.
        """
        self.accessed_at = time.time()

    def remaining_ttl(self) -> Optional[float]:
        """
        Get the remaining time-to-live for this entry.
        
        Returns:
            Remaining TTL in seconds, or None if no expiry is set.
        """
        if self.expiry_time is None:
            return None
        remaining = self.expiry_time - time.time()
        return max(0.0, remaining)
